comment: DO NOT REGENERATE (rules-corpus.json discipline; frozen at the
feature-026 review, GH-343). Per-discipline byte oracle for the
tenball-v1 conformance gate: every expect line harvested ONCE
from the pool-rules crate through the pool-cli judge leg at the
harvestedAt commit and reviewed case-by-case against its cited
clause (WPA Rules of Play eff. 2025-09-15, Section 6 -- 10-Ball;
the semantic source is
crates/pool-rules/tests/tenball_scenarios.rs). Post-freeze
changes ONLY via the erratum protocol: a pinned-clause proof
against the cited text -- NEVER a re-run to fix a red gate; a byte
diff at any conformance leg is resolved by fixing the code to
reproduce THESE bytes. Coverage floor: every foul code
(no-contact, wrong-first-ball, no-rail-after-contact,
illegal-break, ball-off-table, scratch, three-consecutive-fouls),
decisions 12+13 every branch + every error path, both terminals
(ten-ball-pocketed, three-consecutive-fouls), every phase
(break/pushout/play/over), the 6.4 push-out suspension, the 6.6
opponent option, the 6.8 spotted-10 paths (break/push/early/
jumped), the no-golden-break pin, and every tenball RulesError
text reachable through JSON-value inputs.

cases.comment: Fresh rack at the opening-break address (6.2/6.3(a)).
Seat 2 breaks.
6.3(b): four object balls to rails, no pot -- legal; turn passes; the 6.4 window opens (phase pushout).
6.3(b): dry break, three object balls driven -- illegal-break, BIH anywhere (6.9), window closed.
6.3(b) via 2.7: a jumped ball counts toward the four; the jump itself stays a 3.5 foul; only the 10 ever spots (6.8).
6.7: a pot on a foul-free break keeps the table without a call (6.5 exempts the break).
6.8: the 10 pocketed on the break SPOTS -- no golden-break win; breaker continues.
6.9 via 3.1: break scratch is a standard foul -- BIH ANYWHERE (no kitchen relief in 10-ball); window closed.
6.9 via 3.2 applies on the break: first contact must be the 1.
6.4: a declared push out suspends 3.2/3.3 (contact requirement included) -- legal; decision 12 for the opponent; seat held.
6.4/6.7/6.8: balls pocketed on a push out stay down and never count; the 10 spots.
6.4: 3.1 still applies on a push out -- standard foul, no decision, BIH anywhere.
A normal called shot in the 6.4 window consumes it (phase -> play).
6.9 via 3.2: first contact must be the lowest ball.
Rotation follows the surviving set (lowest = 4).
6.9 via 3.3 first sentence: the cue must contact an object ball.
6.9 via 3.3: after contact a ball must reach a rail (or pocket).
6.7: the made call keeps the table; extra balls stay down.
1.7: details irrelevant -- the called 5 off the 1 counts.
6.6: called ball in the wrong pocket, no foul -- decision 13, ball stays down.
6.5/6.6: an uncalled pot on the declared no-call stance is wrongful.
6.7: a clean no-call miss passes the turn -- the safety play of a no-safety-call game (6.5).
6.6 presupposes no foul: a foul + pot is just the foul -- no decision, balls stay (10 excepted).
eightball-v2 lenient-kind convention: an unknown non-call kind reads as the no-call stance.
Sec 6 intro + 6.7/6.8: an early called-and-made 10 is legal, spots, and continues -- NOT a win.
6.7: the called lone 10 in the called pocket wins the rack.
6.6/6.8: the lone 10 in the wrong pocket is a wrongful pot; the 10 spots; game on.
The foul kills the win: called lone 10 made WITH a scratch -- 10 spots, BIH.
6.8 + 3.5: the jumped 10 spots, with the foul.
6.8: no other object ball is ever spotted -- the jumped 6 stays off.
3.13 counter: the second consecutive foul steps to 2 (warning surface is the HUD, not judged).
6.10 via 3.13: the third consecutive foul loses the RACK; the third foul carries the serious-foul cite.

cases.comment: 3.13: any legal shot resets the shooter counter.
6.5: the break is never a called shot.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: the break is not a called shot (WPA 6.5)"}}

cases.comment: 6.4: the push out exists only on the second shot of the rack.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: a push out is only available on the shot immediately after a foul-free break (WPA 6.4)"}}

cases.comment: The break cannot be a push out (the break gate rejects every non-null input).
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: the break is not a called shot (WPA 6.5)"}}

cases.comment: 6.5 via 1.7: every non-break shot requires an explicit stance.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: every shot after the break requires a call or a declared no-call stance (WPA 6.5 via 1.7)"}}

cases.comment: Called ball outside 1-10.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: called ball 11 is not an object ball (1-10)"}}

cases.comment: Called ball not on the table.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: called ball 3 is not on the table"}}

cases.comment: Called pocket must be a kernel pocket index.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-call","message":"tenball-v1: called pocket undefined is not a kernel pocket index"}}

cases.comment: P16 guard: judge refuses while a decision is pending.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"decision-pending","message":"tenball-v1: judge called while a rulebook decision is pending ('wrongful_pot') — resolve it via applyDecision"}}

cases.comment: P17 guard: judge refuses after the match ended.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"match-over","message":"tenball-v1: judge called after the match ended (adapter contract)"}}

cases.comment: bad-state: empty onTable (the nineball guard precedent).
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-state","message":"tenball-v1: state.onTable is empty — no object balls on the table"}}

cases.comment: 6.4 choice 1: the pusher shoots again.
6.4 choice 2: the chooser takes the table.
6.6 choice 1: the shooter continues.
6.6 choice 2: the chooser takes the table.
Unknown decision id (11 belongs to 14.1).
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"tenball-v1: unknown decision id 11 (only 12, pushout_response — WPA 6.4; 13, wrongful_pot — WPA 6.6)"}}

cases.comment: Kind vs pending mismatch.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"tenball-v1: decision 'pushout_response' does not match the pending option ('wrongful_pot')"}}

cases.comment: No pending option.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"tenball-v1: decision 'wrongful_pot' does not match the pending option (none)"}}

cases.comment: Choice out of range.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"tenball-v1: choice 3 out of range for 'pushout_response' (1 the shooter continues | 2 the chooser takes the table)"}}

cases.comment: No decision after the match ended.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"match-over","message":"tenball-v1: no decision can be applied after the match ended"}}
